name: @rackbops/plugin-tracker
description: The task tracker for Rackbops Clerk: reminders, renewals, price drops, one-off research (on the web, or on pages your own browser gathers and sends in through the task API, with a fuller pass on pages the research could not open) and an interest scout and a news watch (through city-hall, with their findings), a want-list watcher (listing pages you paste, BoardGameGeek through its API once its token is set, Shopify stores' new copies in stock through Firecrawl once its key is set, eBay through eBay's own Browse API once its keys are set, and eBay and BoardGameGeek listings you send in through the task API or that eBay's saved-search alert emails forwarded to your alert address carry, which the watcher never opens; with the model checking each new listing and its seller first, through city-hall) by slash command, delivered by DM with buttons, and a daily DM at each person's hour of what is due today and overdue, on docket's SQLite store (/allow, /register, /remind, /renewal, /price, /research, /scout, /news, /want, /tasks, /task, /settings, /web), with a web area for your tasks, history and settings, a web editor to make, change, pause and delete your own tasks (research requests too, made but not changed, and scouts, made and changed), an admin view (with the DMs that did not arrive, raising a person's daily model ceiling, and daily model usage per person), an operator switch that turns the daily budgets off for the alpha, forget-me, a JSON task API with personal API tokens, and a plain-language intake: DM Clerk what you want in your own words, answer its questions, and press Save on the draft it shows

env.description: Comma-separated Discord user ids (spaces around commas allowed) made tracker admins at start (the first admin). Only ever grants: removing an id here does not revoke it. Unset = no admin is seeded.

The Discord server id whose members may use the tracker (the membership gate), or a comma-separated list of server ids (spaces around commas allowed): a member of any listed server passes. Checked on every command and button, in DMs too, except declining an invitation and opting out, so anyone can always stop the messages. Unset = no membership gate: only the admission list (/allow) applies.

The Discord-role check: comma-separated serverId:roleId pairs (a server named twice takes either role). In a server named here, a member passes the membership gate only while they hold one of its roles; a TRACKER_GUILD_ID server not named here stays membership-only, and every server named must be in TRACKER_GUILD_ID or the plugin refuses to load. The TRACKER_ADMIN_DISCORD_IDS admins skip the role, never the membership. Losing the role is like leaving the server: commands are refused and web sessions and API tokens end, while the person's tasks, history and DMs stay. Unset = no role check.

The https origin the bot's HTTP is reached at through its tunnel, e.g. https://clerk.example.com (no path). /web links to <this>/tracker/login, and a form post from any other origin is refused. Unset = no web area: /web says so and its pages answer 404.

Budgets off for the alpha: true or 1 means no daily ceiling (per person or for everyone) holds a model run, bot-wide. Each Job's own caps still apply, usage is still recorded, the People and Usage admin pages show a budgets-off banner, and the person page shows a not-enforced note. Unset, empty, false or 0 = the daily ceilings apply (the default); anything else refuses to load.

The https origin of the city-hall that queues the tracker's model Jobs for docket-runner (no path). With TRACKER_CITY_HALL_KEY and TRACKER_CITY_HALL_CAPABILITY it turns the execute lane, /research, /scout and /news on; any of the three unset = off: /research, /scout and /news say they are not available.
The source bearer key the tracker submits and reads its Jobs with (city-hall's CITY_HALL_API_KEY, Lepid-Labs/city-hall#18). Never logged.
The capability tag every tracker Job names, one only docket-runner carries (plan item 71), e.g. claude-cli:subscription. No default: the execute lane stays off without it.
Cloudflare Access service token id for city-hall's edge, sent as CF-Access-Client-Id. Set with TRACKER_CITY_HALL_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET or not at all.
Cloudflare Access service token secret for city-hall's edge, sent as CF-Access-Client-Secret. Set with TRACKER_CITY_HALL_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID or not at all.

Who may DM Clerk a request in their own words (the plain-language intake): off, admins or everyone registered. Unset or empty = off: DMs are not read. Each turn is a claude -p Job with web search only through the execute lane's city-hall, so it needs TRACKER_CITY_HALL_URL, _KEY and _CAPABILITY; the person presses Save on a draft before anything is made. Needs a bot host with the DM seam (rackbops-discord-bot#620).
The capability tag the intake's turn Jobs name, so a runner of their own takes them and a turn never queues behind research, e.g. claude-cli:intake. Unset = TRACKER_CITY_HALL_CAPABILITY.

A Firecrawl API key for the want-list watcher's Shopify search (Firecrawl's Alexandria, shopify catalog/search_catalog, 5 credits a look). Set = /want source: shopify watches Shopify stores for new copies in stock, once a day by default and never more often; unset = /want source: shopify says it is not available. Sent only to api.firecrawl.dev. Never logged.

The App ID (client id) of an eBay developer Production keyset, for the want-list watcher's eBay search through eBay's own Browse API. Goes with TRACKER_EBAY_CLIENT_SECRET: both set = /want source: ebay searches eBay US through the API, every hour by default; both unset = /want source: ebay is an inbox watch; one without the other refuses to load. Sent only to api.ebay.com. Never logged.

The Cert ID (client secret) of the same eBay keyset as TRACKER_EBAY_CLIENT_ID. The tracker mints an application token from the pair (client credentials, scope https://api.ebay.com/oauth/api_scope) and keeps it in memory only. Sent only to api.ebay.com. Never logged.

BoardGameGeek's XML API Bearer token for the tracker's registered application (boardgamegeek.com/using_the_xml_api). Set = /want source: bgg watches a game's BGG marketplace listings through BGG's API; unset = /want source: bgg makes a watch whose listings are sent in through the task API instead, as for eBay. Never logged.

The https origin of our usr (Rackbops/usr), e.g. https://id.example.com (no path): turns the usr link on, with TRACKER_USR_KEY. People stay in the tracker; each is linked to a usr account by usr's user id. Unset = the usr link is off and nothing changes.

The tracker's usr API key, holding usr:discord only (never tracker:admin or tracker:register), with a usr Discord service set to this app. Required with TRACKER_USR_URL; set without it refuses to load. Never logged.

The usr app the tracker's roles live under (tracker:member, tracker:register); it must match the app on the key's usr Discord service row, which is what usr goes by. Unset = tracker. Needs TRACKER_USR_URL.

usr API key ids (digits, comma-separated: the number in key:<id>, the act.sub of that service's delegation tokens) of the services whose usr delegation tokens the task API takes, such as tracker-mcp's: such a token acts for one linked person, only for the operations its scope names (tracker:list_tasks, tracker:create_task, ...). Unset = the task API takes only trk_ tokens. Needs TRACKER_USR_URL.

The domain the alert-email route receives mail at through Cloudflare Email Routing and the tracker's Email Worker, e.g. alerts.example.com (lower case). Each person gets one private address there (m- and 24 hex digits), shown by /want source: ebay and on the web settings page; eBay's saved-search alerts forwarded to it reach their eBay watches with the same words, and Gmail's forwarding confirmation code is DMed to them. With TRACKER_MAIL_KEY; either unset = off (the route answers 404).

The bearer the Email Worker posts each message to /tracker/mail/inbound with, at least 32 characters; the same value goes in the Worker's CLERK_MAIL_KEY secret. Required with TRACKER_MAIL_DOMAIN; one without the other refuses to load. Never logged.
